title: Heuristic-led eval traffic sentinel for canaries, shadowing and auto-rollback
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a heuristic-driven controller (Eval Traffic Sentinel) that gates canary/A-B/shadow traffic based on prompt-set anchored scorecards. The sentinel evaluates live in-flight responses against curated anchor-prompt reservoirs and cohort-weighted scorecards, computes multi-metric deltas (quality, safety, latency), and enforces hysteresis-aware auto-rollback or partial quarantine policies. This is intended to reduce manual intervention during staged model promotions and to improve detection fidelity for subtle regressions that token-level metrics alone miss.
acceptance_criteria: Controller evaluates incoming canary and shadow requests against configured prompt anchor sets and emits per-route scorecards in <1s median additional latency
Multi-metric gating: quality delta, safety violation rate, and contextual coherence score computed and compared to weighted thresholds per cohort
Automatic rollback trigger that respects hysteresis: requires breach for 3 consecutive evaluation windows or cumulative severity > configured budget
Canary A-B split and shadow-only runs supported via feature flag with per-customer overrides
Integration with Console dashboards (per-route eval_score_delta, alert links) and with rollout conductor API to perform automated flips and partial quarantines
End-to-end test: simulated canary run that produces a rollback event and a follow-up alert with reproducible artifacts (example prompt traces, delta histograms)
implementation_notes: Sentinel runs as a sidecar process in Dedicated/Private and as an infra-managed stage in Hosted pipeline
Use existing golden/anchor prompt reservoir service for sampling; add prompt-weight metadata for cohort weighting
Scorecard engine composes signals: embedding-based semantic similarity, token-level logprob deltas, custom safety classifier score, and latency percentiles
Compute an interpretable composite score (0-100) and expose component breakdown for debugging
Hysteresis implemented with a sliding-window counter + severity accumulator to avoid flapping during noisy traffic
Support a probabilistic sampler for low-volume customers to increase probe coverage while bounding cost
metrics: eval_score_delta (composite): primary gating metric, target <= 3.0 points shift
cohort_safety_rate: fraction of responses violating safety rules, alert if > 0.5% absolute increase
semantic_coherence_drop: fraction of anchor prompts with cosine-similarity reduction > 0.05
p95_inference_latency: ensure sentinel overhead < 50ms median and p95 < 200ms
experiments: Phase 1: Shadow-only evaluation against 10% of traffic for internal customers; collect baseline distributions
Phase 2: Canary gating on low-risk routes with auto-quarantine enabled; run for 48h and analyze alerts
Phase 3: A-B experiments with 10/90 split and sentinel in control path to validate sensitivity and false-positive characteristics
Simulations: synthetic drift injected into model outputs (temperature, prompt truncation) to calibrate thresholds
